# -----------------------------------------
# 1. JOIN Sales + Customers
# -----------------------------------------

joined_df = spark.sql("""
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.product_name,
    s.category,
    s.quantity,
    s.price,
    c.customer_name,
    c.customer_segment,
    c.city
FROM test.bronze.sales_data s
JOIN test.bronze.customers c
ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
LIMIT 100
""")

display(joined_df)

# -----------------------------------------
# 2. Segment Analysis
# -----------------------------------------

segment_summary = spark.sql("""
SELECT
    c.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
    ROUND(SUM(s.price * s.quantity), 2) AS total_spending
FROM test.bronze.sales_data s
JOIN test.bronze.customers c
ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_segment
ORDER BY total_spending DESC
""")

display(segment_summary)

# -----------------------------------------
# 3. Temporary Gold View
# -----------------------------------------

segment_summary.createOrReplaceTempView(
    "customer_segment_summary"
)

print("Temporary Gold View Created")

# -----------------------------------------
# 4. Pie Chart Visualization
# -----------------------------------------

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

pdf = segment_summary.toPandas()

plt.figure(figsize=(8,8))

plt.pie(
    pdf['total_spending'],
    labels=pdf['customer_segment'],
    autopct='%1.1f%%'
)

plt.title("Customer Segment Contribution")
